source_notes: AQA publishes the 7517 specification, including the subject content and the assessment structure. Stage tests and the mock are original questions in AQA's style, not real past-paper items. Numerical answers (conversions, floating-point workings, complexity comparisons, truth tables, algorithm traces) were computed and checked with Python when this course was built.
